events.title: Quadium 4004 Workbench — Limited Demo Coming October 6!
events.summary: Hello everyone, As we get closer to the full release of Quadium 4004 Workbench, I want to share an important milestone. On October 6, a playable demo will go live on Steam — for a limited time only. What the demo is This is a real, working build of the laboratory: you can write code, run it on the simulated MCS-4 system, explore the environment, and get a hands-on feel for how Quadium works. events.title: New Feature: USB I/O Bridge
events.summary: The new USB I/O Bridge extends Quadium 4004 Workbench beyond software emulation, enabling real-time communication with external hardware through a standard USB Serial (CDC) connection. Compatible devices include Arduino Leonardo, Arduino Mega, and virtually any USB CDC device implementing the Quadium USB protocol. What can it do?
